name: Crossandra Summercandle
original_name: クロサンドラ サマーキャンドル
source:
A member of the OCTA branch. Everyone calls her "Sandra."
She has a unique way of speaking because she learned the language from anime.
She's not good at desk work, but she's unusually strong physically.
